description: Wraps POST /api/journey/next. Send a reflection on the current step and receive the next one. If the next step is time-locked, the response says when it unlocks and shows a teaser; call again after that time. The last step returns your postcard.

reflection.description: What the step stirred in you, up to 2,000 characters. Reflections become your postcard at the end, and short excerpts are shown to other travelers on the same step.

name: advance_step
title: Advance to the next step
